points.title: 出生地
points.description: 张衡出生于东汉时期南阳郡（今河南省南阳市），这里是他的故乡，也是他早年生活和学习的地方。在这里，他接受了良好的教育，并形成了对天文、历法、数学和地理的浓厚兴趣。
points.descriptionEn: Zhang Heng was born in Nanyang Commandery (modern Nanyang, Henan Province) during the Eastern Han Dynasty. This was his hometown and the place where he spent his early years, receiving a good education and developing a keen interest in astronomy, calendar, mathematics, and geography.

points.title: 任太史令
points.description: 张衡在105年被任命为太史令，负责天文观测和历法修订。在洛阳，他完成了许多重要的科学研究和发明，包括制作了世界上最早的浑天仪和地动仪，这些发明对后世产生了深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 105, Zhang Heng was appointed as the Grand Astronomer, responsible for astronomical observations and calendar revision. In Luoyang, he completed many important scientific researches and inventions, including the creation of the world's first armillary sphere and seismometer, which had a profound impact on later generations.

points.title: 任尚书
points.titleEn: Served as the Minister of Ceremonies
points.description: 张衡在119年被任命为尚书，参与国家政务。在长安，他继续他的科学研究，并撰写了《浑天仪图注》和《灵宪》等著作，这些作品对后世的天文学和历法学有着重要的贡献。
points.descriptionEn: In 119, Zhang Heng was appointed as the Minister of Ceremonies, participating in state affairs. In Chang'an, he continued his scientific research and wrote works such as 'Commentary on the Armillary Sphere' and 'Ling Xian', which made significant contributions to the astronomy and calendrical studies of later generations.

supporter.zh: 张衡被视为东汉时期最杰出的科学家之一，他的贡献对后世科学的发展产生了深远的影响。他的浑天仪和地动仪是古代中国科技的瑰宝，体现了他的创新精神和科学成就。
supporter.en: Zhang Heng is regarded as one of the most outstanding scientists of the Eastern Han Dynasty, whose contributions have had a profound impact on the development of science in later generations. His armillary sphere and seismometer are treasures of ancient Chinese science, reflecting his innovative spirit and scientific achievements.

critic.zh: 张衡的一些科学理论在当时的条件下可能存在局限性，而且他的政治生涯也并非一帆风顺，他曾因直言进谏而受到贬谪。这些因素可能对他的科学研究和政治决策产生了一定的影响。
critic.en: Some of Zhang Heng's scientific theories may have limitations given the conditions of his time, and his political career was not smooth sailing. He was demoted for speaking out against corruption. These factors may have influenced his scientific research and political decisions.

objective.zh: 张衡是东汉时期的一位多才多艺的科学家和政治家，他的成就不仅限于科学领域，还包括文学、历史和哲学。在历史学界，他被视为中国古代科技和文化的代表人物之一。
objective.en: Zhang Heng was a versatile scientist and politician during the Eastern Han Dynasty, whose achievements extended beyond the scientific field to include literature, history, and philosophy. In the academic community, he is regarded as one of the representatives of ancient Chinese science and culture.

self.zh: 吾尝游于太学，观其书传，皆圣贤之辞也。
self.en: I once traveled to the Grand Academy to read their books and records, all of which are the words of sages and worthies.

others.en: Zhang Heng's talent is unparalleled in the world.
